notes.hashRouting: jitsi-meet routes rooms by path (/RoomName). The demo dev server answers any non-asset path with the app shell, so path routing survives a root-mounted proxy. It does not survive being mounted under a sub-path.
notes.startup: node demo/start.js binds the assigned port immediately and serves a build-progress page, then proxies to the webpack dev server once it answers. The first compile takes minutes; the port never stops responding. Invoked directly rather than through npm start, because npm swallows unknown flags and would drop --port.
notes.externalDependencies: None to start or browse. Signalling is proxied to WEBPACK_DEV_SERVER_PROXY_TARGET only when a room is actually joined.
